author: Zephyr I
title: Double-step LN-ConvLSTM + Wide CNN backbone (32/64 vs 64/128)
abstract: Test whether widening the CNN backbone (32/64 → 64/128) with the same double-step LN-ConvLSTM improves ceiling without domain-specific features under the 30-min cap.

original_submission.content:
from ray import tune
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr')
from networks.cnn_convlstm_layernorm_double_step import CNNConvLSTM_LN_DoubleStep

BASE_SEED = 42

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32, 64]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64, 128]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return CNNConvLSTM_LN_DoubleStep(
        cnn_features_1=int(hparams['cnn_features_1']),
        cnn_features_2=int(hparams['cnn_features_2']),
        conv_lstm_features=int(hparams['conv_lstm_features']),
        attn_temp=1.0,
    )
